parties: Ashok B. Jain (acquirer) / Jain Irrigation Systems Limited (target)
headline: Ashok B. Jain files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE for substantial acquisition of shares in JISL
sum: Threshold-crossing acquisition trigger: Ashok B. Jain crossed a notified shareholding threshold in JISL, triggering immediate public disclosure under SEBI SAST Regulations 2011 Regulation 31(4) and requiring detailed Form A submission within 4 working days.
implication: Regulation 31(4) creates an immediate hard-stop disclosure obligation upon threshold crossing, with no materiality carve-out; acquirer intent (open offer, stake-building, creeping acquisition) must be disclosed in Form A and will determine subsequent open offer triggers under Regulation 10.
detail: Ashok B. Jain submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 19 June 2026 regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Jain Irrigation Systems Limited. The disclosure is triggered when shareholding or voting rights cross a notified threshold (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 55%, 65%, 75%, or 90%). The immediate disclosure under Regulation 31(4) must be followed by a detailed Form A submission within 4 working days, which must contain acquisition cost, price paid, and the acquirer's intent regarding further acquisition and open offer plans.

framework.note: Immediate disclosure obligation triggered upon crossing notified shareholding thresholds; applies to persons acquiring shares, voting rights, or convertible securities.
Detailed disclosure form to be filed within 4 working days of Regulation 31(4) filing; must include acquisition cost, price, and intent (open offer, stake-building, or other).
Open offer trigger - if acquirer's intent in Form A signals continued acquisition or crosses 25% threshold, open offer becomes mandatory.
Defines 'control' and 'promoter' for purposes of determining whether acquirer status triggers additional corporate governance obligations.
Issuer's obligation to make contemporaneous disclosures and ensure director independence reviews upon notification of changed shareholding patterns.

conditions: Form A submission within 4 working days of Regulation 31(4) filing
Acquirer intent disclosure (open offer, stake-building, or creeping acquisition)
Threshold crossing must be above one of the notified thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 55%, 65%, 75%, 90%)
approvals: Form A review by SEBI (for extent of disclosure completeness; not a discretionary approval)

triggers.note: Threshold-crossing triggers immediate disclosure obligation; no materiality carve-out; disclosure window is instantaneous.
Post-acquisition intent disclosed in Form A will determine whether mandatory open offer is triggered (typically at 25% and above).
